Introduction

Ultimate Petanque respects your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use and protect your data across all app features, including the ambassador program, partner program, sponsored events, trust score, badges, push notifications, in-app purchases, promo codes, data export and advertising.
Applicable law and authorities

Ultimate Petanque is published from Quebec, Canada. This policy is governed by Quebec's Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector, as amended by Law 25, and by Canada's Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA). If our answer does not satisfy you, you may contact the Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec (cai.gouv.qc.ca) or the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada (priv.gc.ca). If you live in the European Union, the European Economic Area, Switzerland or the United Kingdom, you keep the rights the GDPR (or its UK equivalent) gives you and may contact your national data protection authority: your data is transferred to and stored in Canada, which the European Commission recognises as providing an adequate level of protection for commercial organisations.
Data collected

Account (email, encrypted password), profile (role, level, club, photo, phone, contact email, handedness, Premium status, XP, badges), game data (matches, challenges, tournaments, ends, detailed actions, sponsored events), directory (players, clubs, courts, tournaments), equipment (boules sets with brand, model, diameter, weight, hardness, price, photos), location (manually entered), federation card, club card, community and weekly leaderboard, trust score (reliability factors, witness attestations), ambassador program (level, referral code, analytics), partner program (portal, ROI, push A/B testing, CRM), purchase data (in-app purchase receipts, promo codes used) and export data (CSV/PDF files generated locally).
Data usage

Your data is used for: app functionality and advanced statistics, cross-device synchronization, community and weekly leaderboard (public profiles only), trust score and badge computation, sponsored events and witness attestations, ambassador and partner analytics, geographically targeted push notifications, in-app purchase and promo code validation, conditional ad display (hidden for Premium users), and export report generation (CSV/PDF with SVG charts).
Data sharing

Your data is only shared with your explicit consent via sharing and publishing features. The contact toggle in preview controls your contact visibility. Other players' contacts are never shared. In-app purchase data is transmitted to Google Play or Apple App Store for validation. No data is sold to third parties.
Data storage

Data stored in secure cloud with local cache for offline use. Automatic delta synchronization with periodic full sync. Export files (CSV/PDF) are generated locally and shared via the device native sharing system. Purchase receipts are stored securely server-side.
Security

Data encryption, secure authentication via OTP or password, Row Level Security on all tables (90+ policies), server-side promo code validation via Edge Functions, purchase receipt verification, automatic anti-cheat detection with trust scoring, rate limiting on sensitive functions, and multi-account detection via device fingerprint.
Your rights

Access, modify and delete your data at any time. Control public visibility and sharing with preview. Contact toggle for your own cards. Full data export in CSV or PDF. Permanent account deletion with email verification.
Sharing feature

Sharing by unique code with read-only or edit permissions. Preview before sharing. Contacts are controllable via toggle for your own cards only. Deep links (ultimatepetanque://) allow direct access to shared cards and meetings.
Public items

Public items are visible to everyone on the map. Preview before publishing. Duplicate detection with existing public items. The Premium badge (silver star) is displayed next to Premium player names on the leaderboard and map.
Terrain Meetups

Meetups allow scheduling playing sessions. Meetup data (title, date, terrain, participants) is stored securely. Only the creator and invited participants have access to meetup details. Share codes are randomly generated. Invitations can be sent from the directory or the community leaderboard.
Community Leaderboard

The community leaderboard displays statistics of players who made their profile public with a silver Premium badge for Premium users. Only public players with at least 1 match are visible. Statistics (win rate, shot, carreau) are calculated automatically. The leaderboard does not collect any additional data.
Push Notifications

The application may send push notifications to alert you about nearby events (within 200km radius), meetup invitations, ranking changes, and share requests. You can precisely control which notification types you want to receive from your profile (Notifications section). Your preferences are stored securely and respected server-side. Your device push token is registered in our database and automatically deactivated on logout.
Crash Reports & Monitoring

The application uses Sentry to automatically collect crash reports and technical errors. These reports contain technical information (device type, OS version, stack trace) but no personally identifiable data. Your IP address is automatically stripped from reports. This data is used exclusively to improve application stability.
Advertising

The app displays banner ads and interstitials via Google AdMob. An active Gold partner may replace the AdMob banner with their own "Gold Sponsor" banner. If there is neither a Gold partner nor an available ad, the slot collapses with no empty strip. A loaded banner occupies only its slot. Ads are removed for Premium users (in-app purchase or promo code). No personal data is shared with advertising networks beyond the device standard advertising identifiers.
In-app purchases and promo codes

The ad removal purchase ($8.99 CAD) is processed by Google Play or Apple App Store. Receipts are validated and stored server-side. Promo codes are validated via a secure Edge Function. Premium status is synced across all your devices.
Data export

CSV and PDF exports are generated entirely on your device. Files contain your match, challenge, tournament and statistics data based on the chosen preset. PDFs may include SVG charts (score progression, performance radar). Files are shared via the native system and do not pass through our servers.
Children
The app is not intended for children under 13. In-app purchases require parental authorization where applicable.
GPS geolocation and proximity

On open, your position can be compared with the profile city to offer an update after a move of more than 50 km, or when the saved city is a province or state while GPS names another city. Nothing is saved without your agreement. GPS is used to find nearby teammates, for active-court alerts (a radius of 1 to 300 km, chosen by you, calculated on the phone) and for the home distance filters (5 to 300 km). If you turn on the active-court push alert, the app sends an approximate position (rounded to about 1 km) and your language, on each open and every 5 minutes while it stays open. You can refuse geolocation in the phone settings.
AI Referee language

The question asked of the AI Referee and the chosen language are sent to the model to produce the answer. The question is not kept: only a daily counter per account is stored. The official FIPJP rules exist only in French and English. For the other six languages, the answer is a translation of that English text, with the same article numbers, and it adds no rule.
Interface languages

The app offers French, English, Spanish, German, Thai, Arabic, Italian and Dutch. Showing a translated label does not send or store any new personal data. The language you picked stays on the device. Choosing Italian or Dutch stores the same language code as the other languages. A longer sentence that is not translated yet stays in English.
Share expiry and revocation

Share requests expire automatically after 7 days. The recipient gets a reminder after 24 h and again after 72 h. With no answer, the request is declined and the sender may resend it (3 resends at most). When an accepted share is revoked, the stats and ELO synced to the recipient are cancelled. The recipient immediately loses access to the shared match. No additional personal data is collected for this feature.
Camera and photos

When you tap "Take a photo" (profile, player, court, club, federation or club card, boules set, tournament poster), the app opens the phone camera. The permission can be withdrawn in the phone settings. Nothing leaves the phone until you confirm the photo. It is then sent to your storage and deleted with the related item or with your account.
ELO seasons

Each calendar year is an ELO season. At season end we archive, for each player, the final ELO, the peak ELO, the final rank, the ELO per role (shooter, pointer, middle), and the match and win counts. These archives feed the record and the ELO awards, and can appear in public rankings if the profile is public. ELO (global and per role) is then compressed 25% towards 1000 for the next season. This compression applies to every player in the same way. Archives stay as long as the account exists.
Tournament hour in Upcoming
The Upcoming section reads the start hour already stored with the tournament in order to display it, then removes the card once that hour has passed. No extra time is stored.
Changes

We may modify this policy. Changes will be notified in the app. The latest update (v1.51.0) includes sections on per-item sponsor analytics tracking (impressions, clicks, CTR per terrain/club/tournament/player), sponsored map markers (brand_color, S badge), sponsor assignment history, and CSV metrics export, in addition to existing sections on push delivery verification, device fingerprinting, A/B test data, ambassador/partner program, sponsored events, trust score, badges, targeted push notifications, partner portal, advertising, in-app purchases, promo codes and data export.
Ambassador Program

The ambassador program has 3 levels (Discovery, Confirmed, Elite) with automatic promotion based on referrals and XP. Data collected includes: analytics (impressions, clicks, CTR), referral code, referral count, total XP. Ambassadors can create sponsored events. Analytics are visible only to the ambassador and administrators.
Partner Program

The partner program has 3 tiers (Bronze, Silver, Gold) with a dedicated portal including: ROI tracking, push notifications with A/B testing and geographic targeting, CRM with referral tracking, brand kit, weekly digest, ROI calculator and monthly goals. Since version 1.57.0, a consent flow is integrated: when an admin approves a sponsorship proposal, the item owner receives a push notification and must accept or decline. Consent data (decision, reason, response date) is stored in the sponsor_proposals table and accessible to the partner, owner and administrators.
Trust Score

The trust score (0-100) is automatically calculated from 13+ factors: multi-player matches, opponent diversity, performance consistency, modification history, play frequency, account age, reports received, stats regularity, match deletion patterns, ELO manipulation, multi-account via device fingerprint, and witness attestations. It determines visibility in the community leaderboard. No additional personal data is collected.
Badges and Gamification

The app offers 13 badges to unlock based on your activity (matches played, shot rate, challenges completed, play streaks, shares, trust score, attestations). Each badge gives 30 to 100 XP. 8 progression levels (Beginner to Expert). The progress bar and unlocked badges are visible on your profile.
Sponsored Events

Sponsored events are created by ambassadors and include: date, location, challenge type, max participants, and witness system. Participants and their results are stored securely. Witness attestations are linked to user accounts. Published rankings are visible to all participants.
Push Delivery Verification

Push notification delivery receipts are periodically verified via the Expo Push Receipts API. This technical data (ticket ID, delivery status) contains no personal information. Invalid tokens are automatically deactivated. Aggregate delivery rates are displayed in the admin dashboard.
Device Fingerprinting

An anonymized device fingerprint is generated to detect multi-accounts as part of the anti-cheat system. This fingerprint is a non-reversible hash and does not identify the device or user. It is used exclusively for fraud detection and is not shared with third parties.
A/B Test Data

A/B announcement tests record aggregate metrics (send count, errors, delivery rate per variant). A/B distribution is random (even/odd token index). No personal data is associated with variants. Results are used solely to optimize future communications.
Per-item Sponsor Analytics

Silver and Gold partners benefit from per-item sponsor analytics tracking: each terrain, club, tournament and player linked via sponsor_id generates impression, click and CTR metrics estimated proportionally from global page data. These metrics are visible in the partner portal and exportable as CSV. Data is anonymized and aggregated — no visitor personal information is collected beyond event counters.
Sponsored Map Markers

Public players linked to a partner via sponsor_id are displayed on the map with a distinctive marker: brand color (brand_color) border and "S" badge. The brand color is set by the partner in their portal. No additional location data is collected — only the position already provided by the player is used.
Sponsorship Consent Data

When a partner proposes to sponsor one of your items (player, club, terrain or tournament), the following data is collected and stored: your decision (acceptance or decline), the decline reason if provided, the response date, and the partner identifier. This data is accessible only to you, the concerned partner and administrators. It is used to manage the sponsorship lifecycle and send appropriate notifications. No consent data is shared with third parties. The owner can view the history of all sponsorship requests in the Sponsors tab of the notification hub.
Sponsor Removal Data

When an owner removes an active sponsor from their item, the following data is recorded: the removal date, the optional reason provided by the owner, and the updated proposal status (owner_removed). This data is accessible to the owner, the concerned partner and administrators. It is used for sponsorship lifecycle management and automatic partner notification.
Consent Expiry Data

Sponsorship consent requests without a response after 7 days are automatically marked as expired. Recorded data includes: the expiration date, the consent_expired status, and the automatic reason. This data is used solely for sponsorship lifecycle management. The partner receives an expiration notification but has no access to the owner's personal data.
Consent Analytics Data

Silver and Gold partners have access to aggregated consent statistics: acceptance rate, average response time, most frequent decline reasons, and breakdown by item type. This data is anonymized and aggregated — no owner personal information is identifiable. It is used to help partners optimize their sponsorship proposals.

Equipment

Deep Linking

The app supports deep links for share codes and meeting codes. Links in the format ultimatepetanque://share/CODE or ultimatepetanque://meetup/CODE automatically open the corresponding card or meeting.
Premium and ad removal

Users can remove ads via a one-time in-app purchase ($8.99 CAD) on Google Play or Apple App Store, or by using a valid promo code. Premium status is linked to the user account and synced across all devices. Purchases are non-refundable except under store policies. Status is linked to account and restorable across devices. A silver star badge identifies Premium users.

Export allows generating CSV or PDF files containing your match, challenge, tournament and statistics data. Smart presets include: by tournament, by season (September-June), comparative between periods, by single match, by player and by challenge. PDFs may contain SVG charts (score progression, performance radar, shot bars). Files are generated locally and shared via the native system.
Partners

The partners page displays official app partners (Gold, Silver, Bronze) with dedicated landing pages. The partner program offers a full portal with ROI tracking including per-item sponsor drill-down and CSV export, automatic rotating carousel for Gold partners on the home page, push notification A/B testing, CRM, brand kit, map markers with brand_color, bulk sponsor assignment with history tracking, automatic cascade deactivation on expiry, and weekly digest. Since version 1.57.0, a consent flow is mandatory: when an admin approves a sponsorship proposal, the item owner (player, club, terrain or tournament) receives a push notification and must accept or decline before the sponsor banner is activated. The owner can decline with an optional reason. The partner is automatically notified of the outcome. Partner spaces are distinct from AdMob advertising content. If you wish to become a partner, contact us by email.

The ambassador program has 3 levels: Discovery (0-4 referrals), Confirmed (5-19 referrals) and Elite (20+ referrals). Promotion is automatic. Ambassadors have a dashboard with analytics, can create sponsored events and have a unique referral code. The referral code is personal and non-transferable.
Trust Score and Anti-cheat

The trust score (0-100) measures the reliability of your statistics. It is calculated automatically and determines your leaderboard visibility. Witness-attested matches have higher weight (2x). Anti-cheat detection analyzes 13+ suspicious behaviors (extreme rates, multi-accounts, single opponent, repeated loss deletion, ELO manipulation). Flagged players are reviewed by administrators who can reverse manipulated ELOs.

Ambassadors can create events with date, location, challenge type and maximum participants. Nearby players receive a notification. Registration is voluntary. Results require attestation from at least 2 witnesses. Rankings are published after validation.

The application sends server-side push notifications for nearby ambassador events (200km radius), meetup invitations, ranking changes, match/challenge share requests, and event reminders. Users can enable or disable each notification type individually from their profile. Notifications are sent via the Expo Push API. Push tokens are stored in our database and automatically deactivated on logout. Users accept receiving notifications by default upon registration and can modify their preferences at any time.
Abuse Protection

Sensitive application functions (promo code validation, purchase recording) are protected by a rate limiting system. Excessive attempts (more than 5 promo code validations or 3 purchase recordings per minute) will be temporarily blocked. This measure protects against brute force attacks and abuse. Blocked users will receive an error message and can retry after a short delay.
Ended journey

When you save your final place, My Journey shows that result (Champion, Finalist, 3rd place or Journey ended) instead of "Waiting". The floating "New match" button goes away so it no longer covers the phase bar. You can reopen that place with "Edit my ranking". The tournament itself stays open for the other players.
Ranking filter

In My Achievements, the Ranking filter sits above the Competition filter. "Podium only" is its first choice. The places 1st, 2nd, 3rd, semi-final, quarter-final, round of 16 and eliminated in groups appear there only after you have saved them. Choosing a place does not change any result.
Translated labels
Buttons, ranks and short labels are shown in Spanish, German, Thai, Arabic, Italian and Dutch. A longer sentence that is not translated yet stays in English. No new data is stored.

The AI Referee answers in the language chosen in the app: French, English, Spanish, German, Thai, Arabic, Italian or Dutch. The official FIPJP rules exist only in French and English. For the other six languages, the answer is a translation of that English text, with the same article numbers, and it adds no rule.
Tournaments in Upcoming

The Upcoming section on Home shows the start hour saved for the tournament's first day. It does not use the placeholder noon carried by the date. Once that hour has passed, the tournament is no longer listed there: it is In progress. No new data is stored.
ELO seasons and season end

Each calendar year is an ELO season. At the end of a season your final ELO, peak, rank and role ELOs are archived, then your ELO (global and per role) is compressed 25% towards 1000 for the next season. This compression is part of how the ranking works: it is neither a penalty nor a loss of points to contest, and it applies to all players in the same way. Season archives are kept as long as your account exists.
ELO Ranking Integrity

Match deletion is monitored by an anti-cheat system. Deleted matches remain in ELO history and trust score penalties apply automatically for suspicious behavior (repeated deletion of losses). Administrators can manually reverse manipulated ELOs. Flagged players are reviewed and may be sanctioned.
Player Transfer

The transfer system allows reassigning a local player's matches to a registered account. The request requires recipient acceptance. Unanswered transfers expire automatically after 30 days. Automatic reminders are sent at 7 and 25 days. Resolved transfers are archived after 90 days.
Announcement A/B Testing

Administrators can test two variants of a push announcement (A/B test) with 50/50 distribution. The winner is automatically determined after 24 hours and resent to the other half of recipients. Test data is stored in the announcements table and contains no personally identifiable information.
Sponsorship Consent

When a partner proposes to sponsor an item (player, club, terrain or tournament) and the request is approved by an administrator, the item owner receives a push notification and must explicitly accept or decline the sponsorship before the sponsor banner is activated. The owner can decline with an optional reason. The partner is automatically notified of the outcome (acceptance or decline). This consent flow ensures compliance with image rights and partner program transparency. Consent data (acceptance, decline, reason, date) is stored securely in the sponsorship proposals table.
Sponsor Removal by Owner

The owner of a sponsored item (player, club, terrain or tournament) can remove an active sponsor at any time from Notifications > Sponsors > My active sponsors. The sponsor banner is removed immediately and the partner is automatically notified with the optional removal reason. Removal is permanent: the partner must submit a new proposal to re-sponsor the item.
Sponsorship Consent Expiry

Sponsorship consent requests expire automatically after 7 days without a response from the owner. A countdown is displayed on each pending request. Upon expiration, the status changes to "consent_expired", the partner is automatically notified, and the sponsor banner is not activated. The owner can still view expired requests in the Sponsors tab history.
